title: Greenway Gym – new rules
text:
GREENWAY GYM – NEW RULES FROM 1 MARCH

To make the gym better for everyone, please follow these rules:

• Always bring a towel and put it on the machines when you use them.
• Please clean the machines after you use them. You can find cleaning spray next to the mirrors.
• Don't use a machine for more than 20 minutes when other people are waiting.
• Put the weights back after you finish.
• Phones: you can listen to music with headphones, but please don't make phone calls in the gym area.
• Children under 16 can only use the gym with an adult.
• Lockers are free, but you need to bring your own lock. Don't leave your things in a locker overnight.

Opening hours are also changing. From 1 March, the gym will open at 6 a.m. (not 7 a.m.) on weekdays. At weekends it will be open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.

Questions? Speak to any member of staff.
Thank you!
